issues.issue: For SIDs, paying/fiscal agent fees go to debt service interest. 'Financial service fees' may be fiscal agent fees. Same judgment applies to detail[6] (p5) and detail[17] (p6).

The SID rule sends warrants with no due-date split to 'debt - due in more than one year'. Here the line is printed above 'Noncurrent liabilities: Due in more than one year', so treating it as current is defensible, but it is an assumption.
